{{Top|leg}}
The '''Heffrin Aqueducts''' were a series of massive, ancient aqueducts on the planet [[Heffrin]] that crisscrossed one of the continents.<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The Aqueducts were built by early [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] explorers, but it was not until the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that the identity of the builders was uncovered.<ref name="The Aqueducts of Haffrin">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|The Aqueducts of Haffrin}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Heffrin Aqueducts were first introduced in the [[2009]] ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', and were later mentioned again in the [[2012]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. However, ''The Old Republic'' mistakenly spelled the planet's name as [[Haffrin]], which is a world in the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]].
